annotations.title: API recommendation: compare paid APIs for a task

description: Describe a task in plain words and compare up to five paid APIs for it across the whole Coinbase Bazaar: each pick with the exact URL to call, method, price in USD, networks, 30-day payers and calls, last paid date and the evidence behind the order. Our own listings are marked, never boosted. No matching tool means no charge. Use when an agent must choose which API to call before paying one. Example: need=check whether a Base token is a honeypot. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 10 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

maxPrice.description: Only listings at or under this price in USD
